pred_diagnosis: Colorectal Liver Metastasis with Portal Vein Tumor Thrombus

1: Solid portion of the liver tumor enhanced in the early phase and washed out in the delayed phase
2: CTA demonstrated a liver tumor with two components: solid and cystic
3: Endoscopic retrograde cholangiography showed no communication with the biliary tree
4: CTAP showed absence of the right portal vein and a perfusion defect throughout the right lobe, suggestive of portal vein tumor thrombus
History of right hemicolectomy for moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon
